response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), counts AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), shares AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind
